info.title: Global Flight Analytics Public Read API
info.description: Source-backed OpenAPI contract for the stable public system, catalog, traffic, aircraft, flight, flight-state, trajectory, route-context, and active-aircraft metric read surface. Advanced intelligence reads and the protected mutation remain intentionally deferred.

servers.description: Same-origin relative server. Deployment origin is selected by the client.

tags.name: Flights
tags.description: Flight catalog and flight profile reads.

tags.name: Flight States
tags.description: Observed flight-state history and latest-state reads.
